title: GTA 6 is 30 FPS even on PS5 Pro
yt_title: GTA 6 is 30 FPS… even on PS5 Pro 😬
description: Rockstar's target for GTA 6 is 30 FPS on every console, PS5 Pro included. The Pro gets PSSR upscaling and ray-traced shadows. A hidden 60 FPS mode is only a dataminer claim (unconfirmed). Out November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
tiktok_caption: GTA 6 is 30 FPS even on PS5 Pro 😬 Deal breaker or not? 👇

lines.text: GTA 6 runs at 30 FPS. Even on PS5 Pro.
lines.headline: 30 FPS. EVEN ON PRO.

lines.text: That's Rockstar's own target, on every console.
So what does the Pro get? PSSR upscaling, for a sharper image.
lines.headline: PSSR

lines.text: Dataminers claim a hidden 60 FPS mode is in the game files.
lines.headline: 60 FPS?

lines.text: That's unconfirmed. Rockstar never announced it, so don't count on it.
It's out November 19th, on PS5 and Xbox Series.
lines.headline: NOV 19

lines.text: 30 FPS. Deal breaker or not? Tell me below, and follow for confirmed GTA 6 news.
lines.headline: DEAL BREAKER?
